decks.notes: The deck aims to control the game through ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and various ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse. It seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Ghost Quarter and Malevolent Rumble while generating advantage with cards like Sire of Seven Deaths and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Devourer of Destiny and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to close out the game quickly once it has established control.

The deck focuses on efficiently tutoring for creatures using a combination of Green Sun's Zenith and Leyline of Abundance to generate mana. Devoted Druid and Delighted Halfling provide additional mana acceleration while also being key combo pieces with Vizier of Remedies. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Nature's Rhythm offer additional utility and protection for your creatures. The toolbox nature of the deck allows for flexibility in finding the right creature for any given situation, making it a versatile and adaptable combo deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Green Sun's Zenith, while also utilizing creatures like Slumbering Trudge and Emrakul, the Promised End to dominate the battlefield. The deck heavily relies on Eldrazi creatures and support cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Malevolent Rumble to maintain control and overwhelm the opponent. The strategy involves quickly ramping up mana to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan with various control elements.

The deck focuses on using instant spells to reanimate powerful creatures such as Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard, allowing for explosive plays and quick wins. It utilizes cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending to set up the combo, while also including disruption like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to control the game. The deck aims to quickly assemble the pieces needed to bring back high-impact threats and overwhelm the opponent before they can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo quickly to generate massive mana advantage and overwhelm the opponent with powerful land drops and utilizing powerful spells. It includes cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to ramp up mana production, while also utilizing lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Urza's Saga to ensure the combo pieces are protected and efficient. The deck aims to quickly search for and play key pieces like Scapeshift and Malevolent Rumble to secure victory through overwhelming resources and board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to quickly ramp up mana and abuse land synergies to cheat out powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift. By taking advantage of land bounce effects and land search cards, the deck can consistently assemble win conditions while also disrupting opponents with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures. The goal is to create explosive turns that put the opponent under immense pressure and overwhelm them with a combination of speed, power, and resilience. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently comboing off and achieving victory through overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Faithless Looting and Burning Inquiry to bring out powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One. It also utilizes cards like Ox of Agonas and Smiting Helix for extra value and potential board wipe. The goal is to aggressively attack the opponent and overwhelm them with a combination of fast creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures and then use cards like Violent Outburst and Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once, overwhelming the opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck includes a mix of cycling creatures, cascade spells, and disruptive cards to help achieve this goal efficiently and consistently. The key strategy is to control the tempo of the game and set up for a game-winning Living End combo.

The focus of this deck is on ramping up mana quickly to play powerful land tutor cards like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to search for specific game-winning lands. Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive turns by untapping lands and increasing mana output. The deck relies on utilizing lands like The Mycosynth Gardens and Urza's Saga to generate additional value and create strong board presence. With a combination of land tutoring, ramp, and combo potential, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful land interactions and threats.

This deck focuses on using a variety of creatures to create powerful combos and synergies, utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to generate value and control the board. The inclusion of toolbox creatures like Endurance and Malevolent Rumble allows for flexibility in dealing with different threats, while cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Spymaster's Vault help to search for key pieces. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building its own board presence and ultimately overwhelming them with a well-timed combo or creature swarm.

The main concept of this Mono Black Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Emperor of Bones and Nethergoyf. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command, and utilize cards like Urza's Saga to generate additional threats. The inclusion of Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer adds versatility to the deck's game plan, making it a formidable force in one-on-one matchups.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The key strategy is to quickly establish a board presence with cards like Scion of Draco, Territorial Kavu, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while controlling the opponent's board with Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Nishoba Brawler to seal the game. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and overpower the opponent in fast-paced matchups.

The deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, removal spells like Prismatic Ending, and graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Solitude and Ketramose, the New Dawn, along with value-generating cards like Ephemerate and Psychic Frog. The mana base is designed to efficiently cast spells of all colors, ensuring consistency in controlling the game and outvaluing the opponent.

This UR Aggro deck is focused on dealing damage quickly and efficiently, utilizing low-cost spells and creatures to pressure the opponent. The deck includes cards like Lightning Bolt, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Monastery Swiftspear to keep up the pressure, while also running cards like Unholy Heat and Surgical Extraction for removal and disruption. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, controlling the board with direct damage and evasion to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board with a mix of countermagic, removal spells, and disruption while also digging for key cards through card draw and manipulation. The deck seeks to maintain control of the game by consistently answering threats from the opponent and out valuing them in the long run. It prioritizes efficient removal, potent counterspells, and card advantage. Through its various tools, this Dimir Control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and overpower them with its own powerful spells and creatures.

The main theme of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck includes efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, as well as powerful instant and sorcery spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board and deal damage quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Goblin Bombardment and Ranger-Captain of Eos to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a strong mana base and a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, this deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively.
